About Us
Acme Digital Sdn Bhd is a growing product studio in Kuala Lumpur. We love Python workshops and celebrate Chinese New Year together.

Job Responsibilities
- Build responsive web pages with React and TypeScript
- Work closely with designers and backend engineers

Requirements
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field
- 0-1 year of working experience; fresh graduates are welcome to apply
- Solid understanding of JavaScript, HTML and CSS
- Familiar with Git
- Good command of English

Nice to have
- Experience with Next.js
- Knowledge of Tailwind CSS

Benefits
- Medical insurance, free parking, AWS certification sponsorship
